reading.zh: 从左到右：先产生留痕（操作日志、审批轨迹、权限变更与登录日志），再由不可篡改与保留期约束兜底——只追加、审计与轨迹保留不少于 10 年、登录日志 1 年、哈希可校验。
reading.en: Left to right: traces are produced first (operation log, approval trail, permission and login logs), then immutability and retention enforce append-only storage, ten-year retention and verifiable hashes.
